criteria: Correct: The FOL rule aligns with the meaning of the NL sentence

Partial: one and only one of the following errors occur - The FOL rule does not align with the NL in some parts but does not explicitly contradict the NL - Missing important predicates, or having obviously irrelevant predicates - Wrong quantifier when the NL has explicit hints such as "For all..." or "Some..." - Wrong use of variables, such as free/redundant variables, wrong variable association, or redefining variables
Incorrect: More than one Partial error was found in an example - The FOL rule explicitly contradicts the NL meaning.
